$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers: everyone who opens this project gets them (after a one-time approval). Ships EMPTY on purpose: every server adds its tool schemas to every session, and a 5-project audit found the old defaults (filesystem, github) unused — built-in file tools and the gh CLI cover them. Add only servers this project really uses; examples are in CATALOG.md (MCP servers). Secrets: reference env vars like ${GITHUB_TOKEN}, never hardcode.
